notes.title: Luminoso 1.2.0 - Workshop is here!
notes.notes: An update to Luminoso is now available that adds access to Steam Workshop to the game. Now you can share your level creations with other players, and play levels others have created.

notes.title: Luminoso 1.1.5
notes.notes:
A small update to Luminoso is now available with the following changes:

[list][*] Levels 25, 31, 37, 39, 44, and 58 have been improved to prevent unintended solutions. You may want to play these again.
[/list]
